thread:
leo: Quick sync — we need a lightweight rollout plan for the latency-sensitive model switch (v1 -> v2 quantized) that satisfies enterprise SLAs and a handful of early customers. Key constraints: EU region, high-traffic routes, and canary must not increase p95 beyond 50ms.
anya: +1. Do we want a segmented traffic slice (by customer tier + region) or a percentage-based canary? I think combining both reduces blast radius.
jamie: Prefer segmented. Suggested approach: 1) 5 enterprise customers in EU (manual opt-in) 2) 2% baseline for all traffic in EU for 48h 3) autoescalate to 10% if latency/quality OK.
rachel: Observability checklist: have per-flag SLO dashboards, error budget alerts, and a kill-switch runbook. Also need synthetic traffic hitting p95 and end-to-end request traces.
leo: Agreed. For experiments/A-B we should also capture token-level quality metrics (BLEU-ish or custom eval) vs latency. If quality regressions > 1% on eval prompt set — auto rollback.
anya: For feature-flag rules, proposal snippet:
```
flag: model_switch_v2_quant
rules:
  - segment: enterprise_eu
    pct: 0-20
  - segment: general_eu
    pct: 0-2
  - experiment: ab_latency_tune
    pct: 1
```
jamie: Implementation notes for runtime: We'll serve v2 on separate pool with reduced batch size; route policy should prefer low-latency pods for enterprise tier. We need a fallback to v1 with stateful KV cache warming — otherwise cold KVs blow latency.
rachel: Fallback policy draft: 1) immediate fallback if p95 > 2x baseline for 5m 2) graceful degrade: route 50% traffic back, warm cache for 10m, then re-evaluate 3) if error-rate spike >= 0.5% -> full rollback and incident page.
leo: Launch criteria checklist (minimal):
- infra: dedicated EU pool + autoscale rules
- observability: dashboards + synthetic probes
- QA: 1000 eval prompts pass quality gate
- customer opt-in list + comms
- rollback playbook documented
anya: Who's on-call for the first 72 hours of ramp? We should have eng-runtime + SRE on shift, plus a product PM to coordinate comms.
jamie: I can own runtime for the ramp days. rachel — can you pair SRE 1st 48h? :eyes:
rachel: Yes, SRE will cover. We'll add a runbook to /confluence and link in the experiment flag.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered by leo at 1964507925 — staged rollout started: model_switch_v2_quant -> 2% in eu-general, enterprise_eu manual.
anya: First checks in 15m. I'll post the initial SLO numbers and sample traces. If anything looks off we hit the kill-switch.
leo: Thanks — will follow live. Keep all customer comms gated through PMs. :rocket:
